items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: He also taught Cootie Williams. Cootie Williams traveled with us when I was a little kid on the carnival

ctx.x: He played all of the saxaphones?

Yes. You know, if you can play one saxaphone, generally you can play the other, you know -- it's just a matter of -- he was playing C Melody, I think, at the time, which I think is extinct now. They don't have C Melody instruments any more, but he was really a great musician.
And he taught, other than Lester, the ones that you would know. I think if you're talking about history, he

items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: And I would be with Lee and Irma. ... Lester, then, would go on the stage with his father and his mother and Irma and Lee with the saxophone act.

ctx.x: All of them were saxophone players. There was Lester, Lee and ISMA Heerman.

items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: He talked to Lester's father. He had the band... And that's how I went on the show with Lester.

ctx.x: Well, that's why he took you.
Yeah. So I heard Lester playing.
